sourceEvidence.note: Public same-name dealer listings confirm identity leads, but no source-logo raster was reviewed as a suitable edit target in this proposal pass. If a recognizable published logo is confirmed, preserve it instead of replacing it with this concept.

generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original independent automotive retailer logo concept, transparent PNG master
Primary request: create a tasteful robust identity for "JWG Auto Sales LLC", using those exact letters and no other text.
Identity idea: a custom bold interlocking "JWG" typographic symbol that feels engineered and balanced, with distinctive negative-space cuts, paired with a clean smaller "AUTO SALES LLC" subtitle. No car drawing.
Style: sophisticated Colorado independent dealer; timeless American modernist signmaking, exceptionally clear flat-vector geometry and generous internal counters; works at small header and square social icon sizes.
Palette: dark ink black and an energetic restrained golden amber accent, solid fills.
Composition: one centered horizontal/stacked logo lockup on truly transparent background, margins free of stray pixels, crisp letterforms.
Constraints: exact spelling "JWG Auto Sales LLC" (not "JWG Auto Sale"), no slogans, no watermark, no mockup, no photos, no gradient, no strokes too thin to survive 32px, no shield/crown/wings/gear/steering wheel. Independent website proposal, not official.

holdReasons: Concept not compared with recognizable same-business published logo
No separate 32/48/64px compact mark and on-dark/accent exports
No maintained source-pack hashes or six-template screenshot review
